title: Investigate "Change my decision" is working properly ?

messages.text: From PR-001, i was changed my decision . but i didn't see any catch up

You're right, it did not work properly. Thank you for checking.
What happened: when you first decided 'rejected' (04:02), the agent that made PR-001 was waiting for a decision. It took that first decision and stopped waiting. Your change to 'changes requested' (04:04) was saved correctly, but no one was waiting any more, and my own wait only covers threads, not proposals. I learned of the change only because you told me in T-005.
Your request is in work now: de-illusion-style started the image-frames / video version at 04:20 (see T-006).
Fix: I opened incident I-045 and sent a toolsmith. My standing wait will also wake on every proposal decision, including a changed or undone one, and agents can keep waiting after a first decision. Until it lands, I check the Proposals page by hand each time I wake.

Catch-up: fixed and working.
- The fix landed yesterday at 22:54Z (incident I-045). Every decision event on a proposal now wakes everyone waiting: a first decision, an undo, and a changed decision. My standing wait wakes on them too, not only on threads.
- Proof from today: you accepted PR-003 (option A) at 09:12:55Z, and my wait woke within a second with your full note. The work was planned within two minutes: A is applied first and B is researched alongside it.
- PR-001 and PR-002 also have their own background waits for a changed decision, and they're still armed.
- If you change any decision now, the owner and I see it at once. I'll treat the change as the new spec, as with PR-001 rev 2.
Nothing is open on this, so I'll leave the thread for you to close.
